title: Figure 45: acoustic pressure magnitude contours at 5000 Hz in water
description: ANSYS 12.1 contour plot of the magnitude of pressure (Pa) for 5,000 Hz with 25 elements per wavelength in water, uniformly radiating sphere EPW=25. Pressure concentrated at the source corner decaying into the blue field; legend 134 to 6782 Pa. BAASS underwater acoustics capability demonstration.
